abstract: The authors gathered 20 patients having Swyer's syndrome and performed a bilateral gonadectomy and carried out a pathohistologic evaluation of the streak gonads. A more frequent occurrence of streak gonad tumors was found together with the possibility of tracing the merge gonadoblastoma into dysgerminoma (the youngest patient was 15 years old). In 95% of the streak gonads checked an ovary-like stroma was found. In 11 of the patients (55%) one of the above mentioned tumors was found. A frequent finding was the presence of Leydig-type cells, calcifications and the remains of Wolffian canals. In three streak gonads, the corpora albicans-like formations were found.
abstract_ja: 20例のSwyer症候群患者に対して両側性腺摘出術を施行し、索状性腺の病理組織学的評価を行った。索状性腺の腫瘍発生はより高頻度であり、融合性性腺芽腫がディスジャーミノーマへ移行する過程をたどれる可能性があった(最若年例は15歳)。検査した索状性腺の95%で卵巣様間質が認められた。患者の11例(55%)で上記腫瘍のいずれかが認められた。頻繁にみられた所見として、ライディッヒ型細胞、石灰化、ウォルフ管の遺残があった。3つの索状性腺では白体様構造が認められた。
